name: Abra-ca-Empty
overview: Four travelers with completely opposite packing styles must share a single suitcase on a minimalist getaway. Every new item packed means something else has to be left behind, forcing nonstop negotiations, hilarious compromises, and unexpected conflicts. As a packing expert, a maximalist, a beauty lover, and a photography enthusiast battle over limited space, their friendship is put to the ultimate test. Will they survive the trip with both their suitcase—and their bond—intact?
